subject: german
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in German on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (German↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: What does 'die Freizeit' mean?
questions.explain: 'Die Freizeit' means 'free time / leisure time'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I play football'?
questions.explain: 'Fußball spielen' = 'to play football'. 'Klavier spielen' would be 'to play piano'.

questions.q: What does 'Ich treffe mich mit Freunden' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sich treffen mit' means 'to meet up with', so this is 'I meet up with friends'.

questions.q: What does 'Ich lese normalerweise abends' mean?
options: I usually read in the evenings
I used to read in the evenings
I have to read in the evenings
I will read in the evenings
questions.explain: 'Normalerweise' means 'usually' and 'abends' = 'in the evenings', so this is 'I usually read in the evenings'.

questions.q: What is 'Weihnachten'?
questions.explain: 'Weihnachten' means 'Christmas'. 'Ostern' is Easter.

questions.q: What does 'Silvester' refer to?
questions.explain: In German, 'Silvester' is New Year's Eve (31 December). Christmas Eve is 'Heiligabend'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'We celebrate Christmas with the family'?
options: Wir feiern Weihnachten mit der Familie
Wir vermeiden Weihnachten mit der Familie
questions.explain: 'Feiern' = 'to celebrate' and 'mit der Familie' = 'with the family', so this is correct.

questions.q: What does 'Geschenke schenken' mean?
questions.explain: 'Schenken' means 'to give (as a gift)', so 'Geschenke schenken' = 'to give presents'.

questions.q: What does 'ein Sänger' mean?
questions.explain: 'Ein Sänger' is a male singer (female: 'eine Sängerin'); 'a song' is 'ein Lied'.

questions.q: What does 'berühmt' mean?
questions.explain: 'Berühmt' means 'famous', e.g. 'Er ist berühmt für seine Musik' = 'He is famous for his music'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I follow many influencers online'?
questions.explain: 'Folgen' takes the dative, so 'Ich folge vielen Influencern online' (present tense) = 'I follow many influencers online'.

questions.q: What does 'die sozialen Medien' mean?
questions.explain: 'Die sozialen Medien' means 'social media' (also 'soziale Netzwerke' = social networks).

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Yesterday I went to a concert' (past)?
options: Gestern bin ich zu einem Konzert gegangen
Morgen gehe ich zu einem Konzert
Ich möchte zu einem Konzert gehen
questions.explain: 'Bin... gegangen' is the perfect tense of 'gehen' (with sein) = 'went'; with 'gestern' the perfect is correct.

questions.q: What does 'Das gefällt mir gar nicht' mean?
options: I don't like that at all
questions.explain: 'Gefallen' = 'to please' and 'gar nicht' = 'not at all', so 'Das gefällt mir gar nicht' = 'I don't like that at all'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to watch a film' (polite)?
questions.explain: 'Ich möchte' = 'I would like' (polite conditional). 'Ich will' means 'I want' — more direct.

questions.q: What does 'Eigentlich mag ich Popmusik' mean?
options: I used to like pop music
questions.explain: 'Eigentlich' means 'actually/in fact'. (Don't confuse it with 'aktuell' = 'current'.)

questions.q: What does 'wandern' mean?
questions.explain: 'Wandern' means 'to hike/ramble' (a planned walk), not to 'wander' aimlessly.

questions.q: What is 'das Oktoberfest'?
questions.explain: 'Das Oktoberfest' is the famous folk festival/funfair held in Munich.

questions.q: What does 'eine Sendung' mean (TV)?
questions.explain: 'Eine Sendung' is a TV/radio programme (from 'senden', to broadcast).

questions.q: What does 'Ich interessiere mich für Musik' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sich interessieren für' means 'to be interested in', so this is 'I am interested in music'.
